action_items: (LOW) Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription on rn-detail-dialog and similar Radix DialogContent components to silence the a11y console warning. Not blocking; cosmetic only.

(NICE-TO-HAVE) Add a regression backend test that re-confirms _enrich_with_parent_assignee on GET /api/picking-notes (existing test only checks /api/racking-notes). Code path is symmetric and verified by code-review.
critical_code_review_comments: _resolve_assignee + _enforce_assignee in server.py centralize assignment validation cleanly — they handle missing user, inactive user, and module-access checks consistently. ✅

GET /api/users/assignable correctly uses get_current_user (not require_admin), so any authenticated user can fetch the dropdown options — needed because non-admin Stock In users still need to see the list when admins assign. ✅
_enrich_with_parent_assignee batches a single users.find({_id: $in:[...]}) call rather than N+1 — good perf pattern. ✅
AssigneeSelect.jsx UNASSIGNED sentinel value 'unassigned' is converted to null on submit; this matches backend's null-as-unassigned semantics. ✅

StockInPage rn-edit/rn-delete disable logic checks `assigned_to_user_id && assigned_to_user_id !== currentUser.id && currentUser.role !== 'admin'` — correct. Same pattern in RackingNoteTab and StockOutPage. ✅
Receipt Note PUT correctly emits user-audience notification on assignee change (notification audience='user', target_user_id=new_assignee). ✅
Minor: Some Radix DialogContent components emit 'Missing Description' a11y warnings — fix by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby. Non-blocking.
